record.question: Which of the following penicillin preparation is preferred for use in syphilis due to its long duration of action?
record.explanation: Answer A: Benzathine penicillin. Benzathine penicillin G is the recommended long-acting penicillin preparation for syphilis in standard treatment regimens. Source/context note: Regimen depends on syphilis stage, pregnancy, allergy, and current guidelines. Reference: https://www.cdc.gov/std/treatment-guidelines/p-and-s-syphilis.htm. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
